installer-gui-script.title: Tanghim {VERSION}
installer-gui-script.welcome:
Tanghim {VERSION}
This installer will place the Tanghim (Transmitter) and Tanghim Receiver audio plug-ins (VST3, Audio Unit, CLAP) into your system plug-in folders.
The Tanghim Receiver for Max for Live (M4L) is included as an optional component — enable it on the next screen if you use Ableton Live.
The plug-ins are ad-hoc codesigned. Your DAW may warn about an unidentified developer the first time you scan — this is expected.

choice.title: Tanghim (Transmitter)
choice.description: VST3, Audio Unit, and CLAP versions of the main Tanghim plug-in.

choice.title: Tanghim Receiver
choice.description: VST3, Audio Unit, and CLAP versions of the Receiver plug-in (pitch-bend / MPE output for non-MTS-ESP synths).

choice.title: Tanghim Receiver for Ableton Live (M4L)
choice.description: Max for Live device for Ableton Live users. Installs to your user Ableton library.
